name: HP Adhesives Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2021, HP Adhesives Ltd manufactures and distributes adhesives 
and sealants along with other ancillary 
 products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HPAL manufactures solvent cements, synthetic rubber adhesives and PVA adhesives, silicone sealants and gasket shellac & also trades in Ball Valves, PTFE and Masking Tape

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 44.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 10.3% over last 3 years.
